function: CSI compression and feedback: parameter-free amplitude-pooling encoder at UE and learned SEResBlock CNN refiner at BS reconstruct the CSI (p. 3-4, 6-8).
system: Single-cell downlink FDD massive MIMO, Nt=32 BS antennas, single-antenna UE, OFDM with 1024 subcarriers; QuaDRiGa 4x4 cross-polarized UPA; no RIS; band not stated (p. 3, 10).
method: End-to-end trained CNN autoencoder-style (MSE reconstruction loss, Adam): parameter-free amplitude-pooling encoder, unpooling decoder, SEResBlock refiner; PoolCsiNet+ adds dilated pooling (p. 6-9).
data_channel: COST 2100 indoor and outdoor dataset adopted in [15] (100k train, 30k validation, 20k test); QuaDRiGa urban micro dataset (50k train, 10k test) (p. 10).
test_conditions: Same-dataset training and testing per scenario; smaller training sets; general model trained on mixed 1-6 degree angular spreads, tested at 2, 4, 6 degrees (p. 10, 13, 15).
baselines: Learned: CsiNet, BCsiNet, BCRNet-CM (NMSE, cosine); CS-CsiNet, ImCsiNet-m, CFnet, IALNet (rate). Classical: Type II codebook [52] (rate) (p. 10-11, 14).
metrics: NMSE, cosine similarity, average achievable rate per user, trainable parameters and FLOPs at UE and BS (p. 9, 11, 12, 14).
complexity: Table II: trainable parameters and FLOPs at UE and BS; 0 parameters and 11K FLOPs at UE, 231K parameters and 12.65M FLOPs at BS (eta=1/4) (p. 12).
openness: none: no code or data link; uses the COST 2100 dataset of [15] and the QuaDRiGa simulator [42] (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 10: "the same COST 2100 dataset adopted in [15], [19], [20], and [21]"; p. 10: "QuaDRiGa [42] to generate channel dataset in an urban micro (UMi) scenario". Both are named in q1.
q2_support: p. 15: "a mixed training dataset for general model by randomly sampling the angular spread of sub-paths". The mixed set covers the tested spreads and specific models are trained and tested at the same spread; no unseen scenario, band, dataset or antenna setting is tested.
q3_support: p. 14: "along with a codebook-based method, i.e., Type II [52]" (non-learned, achievable rate); p. 10: "NN-based lightweight methods, namely CsiNet [15], BCsiNet [19]" (learned, NMSE).
q4_support: p. 12: "The proposed PoolCsiNet only includes 11K FLOPs at the UE"; Table II lists trainable parameters and FLOPs at UE and BS.
q5_support: p. 10: "the same COST 2100 dataset adopted in [15], [19], [20], and [21]". The paper gives no link or DOI for its own code or data; the QuaDRiGa data are generated by the authors.
notes: Included, area 2 (CSI compression and feedback; BS has 32 antennas, so the system check passes). Reviewer to confirm two marks. q2=0: the generalization test on p. 15 trains a general model on angular spreads sampled from 1 to 6 degrees and tests at 2, 4 and 6 degrees, inside the training range. q5=1 rests on the COST 2100 CSI dataset of [15] being a shared public dataset; the paper states no link and releases no code.
